text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Less than three days remained until Acting 
Principal Kashimoto's managed education 
program began...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nutritious penalty drink?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... In the controlled education 
program, we wrote down the nutritional 
value of everything we ate every day, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you eat too much, or if it wasn't 
enough, then tomorrow's meal will...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently I have to drink this super 
bitter... nutrient-packed penalty 
drink..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If this strictly managed education program 
starts, does that mean we'll have daily 
pop quizzes in every single subject~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-And failing marks mean weekend 
supplementary classes...! Eeeeek~! That's 
so depressing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ha! That's it! Times like this call for a 
refreshing trip to a secret power spot—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that's right. For safety reasons, 
I'll have to declare where I'm going when 
heading out, won't I...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: NOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it, this is crazy! Such a cramped 
and unhappy academy, desu!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I love an academy that is full of freedom 
and happiness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Taiki Shuttle's shout, the 
surrounding students chimed in with 
enthusiastic agreement.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, direct negotiations! Let's 
go talk with Acting Principal Kashimoto!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the Director's Office, I notice 
a group of Umamusume led by Taiki Shuttle 
arguing with Acting Director Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Strict management education program, we 
oppose you!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So please do not make me repeat myself. 
The implementation has already been 
decided.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~! But, but! I don't want an academy 
where my friends are sad, desu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I love this academy where my friends can 
eat ice cream and enjoy delicious meals!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Retesting every day is so cruel, yes! It 
makes me so, so very sad, yes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what persistent students. Day 
after day... I wonder how many you make 
today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Respect autonomy, don't abolish the 
Aoharu Cup." ...The requests are 
terrifyingly unanimous.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, enforcing strict management 
without her understanding won't yield any 
results. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Students, let us make a wager.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "wager" proposed by Acting Principal 
Kashimoto once again sent shockwaves 
through the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Defeat Acting Principal Kashimoto's team 
in the Aoharu Cup’... is that it?"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As of today, the abolition of the Aoharu 
Cup has been postponed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Also, let us hold off on implementing the 
Managed Education Program until the Aoharu 
Cup concludes.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Defeat Team <First> in the Aoharu Cup— the team I 
have forged under strict, meticulous 
management.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If we can stop it, the managed education 
program will not be implemented. The 
academy's culture of freedom will remain 
as it is.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, if you challenge us and fail to 
prevent our victory, you will accept the 
program.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Favorable terms, wouldn't you say? After 
all, you only need to prevent our team 
from winning.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—At the same time, if we fail to prevent 
the victory, it will serve as proof that 
strict management is indeed the right 
path.”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's easier to persuade others if team 
management is predicated on total 
control... Is that what this is about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her declaration, the Umamusume 
she handpicked right away were all 
top-tier elites.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glace, the strength-proud Umamusume 
who loves a good challenge and whose 
catchphrase is "Guts!"—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, just the right weight! Alright then, 
off I go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I can do it, I will do it, pure guts~!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What is with that girl!? She's pulling an 
ultra-huge tire at insane speed?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Little Cocon, a cynical Umamusume 
endowed with extraordinary lung capacity.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that guy the super strong—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, there are less than 5 
minutes left in the break. Move over to 
the pool immediately."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by these two, they assembled an elite 
Umamusume team that fully subscribed to 
their strict, micromanaged system.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Chairwoman Akikawa absent, Tracen 
Academy was swallowed up in a storm of 
trouble in the blink of an eye.
choice_data_list: What am I supposed to do...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa says her hands are tied 
right now, so it seems she won't be able 
to return right away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Still... um, I was told there's no need 
to rush, so..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman knows this academy inside 
and out, so she might be seeing things 
from a different perspective..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So... let's do what we can, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, Acting Director Kashimoto's 
methods are far too overbearing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We cannot simply sit quietly and let them 
rob the Umamusume of their free academy 
life.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"I shouldn't say this too loudly, but... 
Please win, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Management is indeed necessary. 
Injuries or illness resulting from a lack 
of oversight must absolutely be avoided."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot agree with Acting 
Director Kashimoto's method of simply 
suppressing it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I prefer Tracen Academy, where the 
Umamusume can be carefree and express 
themselves."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave a firm nod to Tazuna-san as she 
smiled like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, gather team members. And then our 
goal is to take down Team <First>...!
